scope: Bounded circulating-factor/immune primary FSGS and separate APOL1-associated kidney injury branch; excludes other genetic, adaptive, viral and drug-associated FSGS. APOL1-associated disease is not classified as idiopathic primary FSGS.

paragraphs.text: Circulating permeability activity was associated with FSGS recurrence after transplantation.

These selected findings describe a bounded candidate, whose overall explanation has not been independently checked against current literature. Abstract-level inspection; no independent domain review or complete methods appraisal. In a single-group phase 2a study, 13 adherent participants with two APOL1 risk variants and biopsy-proven FSGS had a mean 47.6% proteinuria reduction at 13 weeks. Drug targeting and approval do not establish every proposed mechanism or benefit in every phenotype.
